in_arabic.name: زاويار
in_arabic.meaning: اسم يعني زاوية أو ناظر أو بصر أو رؤية بمعنى النظر إلى الزوايا
in_arabic.long_meaning: اسم ذو أصول عربية، يعود إلى الجذر اللغوي 'ز-و-ي' الذي يحمل معاني الزاوية، الناظر، البصر، أو الرؤية. يستخدم في اللغة العربية ليعبر عن الشخص الذي ينظر إلى الزوايا أو يرى ما لا يراه الآخرون. يعتبر هذا الاسم من الأسماء التي تعبر عن الفضائل والخصال الحميدة في الشخصية الإسلامية.

in_urdu.name: زاویار
in_urdu.meaning: ایک ایسا نام جو زاویہ یا نگاہ یا بصیرت کے معنی میں ہے
in_urdu.long_meaning: یہ نام عربی زبان کی جڑ 'ز-و-ي' سے ماخوذ ہے، جس کے معنی ہیں زاویہ، نگاہ، بصیرت یا نظر۔ یہ نام ان خصوصیات کو ظاہر کرتا ہے جو ایک فرد کو خاص بناتی ہیں، جیسے کہ بصیرت، گہری سوچ، اور اچھائی کو دیکھنے کی صلاحیت۔ جنوبی ایشیائی اسلامی روایت میں، یہ نام فرد کی ذاتی اور روحانی خوبیوں پر زور دیتا ہے۔

data.cultural_impact: The term "Zawiyah" (plural: Zawiyat) refers to a Sufi retreat or a religious institution that provides shelter and protection, both physical and spiritual, for disciples seeking personal growth and enlightenment. These sacred spaces are characterized by their seclusion from the material world, allowing individuals to devote themselves entirely to spiritual practice and self-reflection. They serve as vibrant communities, fostering the study of Islamic traditions, the practice of Dhikr (remembrance of God), and the nurturing of a strong spiritual bond with the Creator. Zawiyas have been the cornerstone of Sufism, offering an environment where seekers can retreat from the hustle and bustle of everyday life to focus on their journey of spiritual development.
data.spiritual_significance: The name "Zawiyah" signifies a deeply spiritual place, a sanctuary where one can encounter the divine and embark on a transformative journey towards inner peace, self-realization, and closeness with God. The term evokes the image of a hidden oasis, a nurturing environment where one can connect with their inner self and strengthen their connection with the divine. The spiritual significance of a Zawiyah lies in its role as a powerful reminder of the ultimate goal of human existence: to utilize every moment of life in pursuit of a deeper, more meaningful relationship with God. Through the practice of various spiritual disciplines, such as Dhikr, meditation, and acts of worship, individuals can unlock the secrets of their heart and discover their true purpose in life. A Zawiyah serves as a beacon of hope, offering a respite from the collective suffering of the world and inviting all sincere seekers to come and partake in the eternal, transformative, and profound experience of the divine presence.
